meta.name: google-news-api-skill
meta.description: This skill helps users automatically extract structured news data from Google News via BrowserAct API. Agent should proactively apply this skill when users express needs like searching for news about a specific topic, tracking industry trends, monitoring public relations or sentiment, collecting competitor updates, getting latest reports on specific keywords, monitoring brand exposure in media, researching market hot topics, summarizing daily industry news, tracking media activities of specific individuals, retrieving hot events from the past 24 hours, extracting structured data for market research, monitoring global breaking news.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动从谷歌新闻提取结构化新闻数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要自动抓取谷歌新闻做市场或舆情分析
copy.tagline_en: Automatically extract structured news data from Google News
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automatically fetch Google News for market or sentiment analysis

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能通过 BrowserAct API 从 Google News 提取结构化新闻数据，包括标题、来源、发布时间和链接。你只需提供搜索关键词和时间范围。
howto.when: 当你提出搜索特定主题新闻、跟踪行业趋势、监控品牌曝光、收集竞品动态等需求时，Claude 会自动调用此技能。

say.text: 帮我搜一下过去24小时关于特斯拉的新闻。
say.note: Claude 会提取并返回新闻列表。

say.text: 查查这周人工智能行业的热点。
say.note: Claude 会按过去一周筛选并返回结果。

say.text: 监控某品牌过去一周的媒体曝光。
say.note: Claude 会提取相关新闻并汇总。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can extract structured news data from Google News via BrowserAct API, including headlines, sources, publication times, and links. You just provide search keywords and time range.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you express needs like searching news on a specific topic, tracking industry trends, monitoring brand exposure, or collecting competitor updates.

say_en.text: Search for news about Tesla in the past 24 hours.
say_en.note: Claude will extract and return the news list.

say_en.text: Get top stories on AI this week.
say_en.note: Claude will filter by past week and return results.

say_en.text: Monitor media coverage of a brand over the past week.
say_en.note: Claude will extract relevant news and summarize.
